text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a White Day gift, I invited Yamanin Zephyr
to a nature park today—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Flowers that don't naturally grow in Japan are blooming here.
I wondered if the unfamiliar environment meant early summer stormy winds, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Feeling this refreshing, brisk wind brings me peace of mind.
Nature is truly powerful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a place where diverse flora and fauna thrive,
Yamanin Zephyr would surely be delighted.
Thinking that, I chose this spot, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, so animals pass through here as well, do they?
Though it seems out of the path of the prevailing natural winds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There is no... fierce gust.
It is much gentler, yet full of the rustling breath of life.
choice_data_list: This place functions as its own self-contained world.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That is certainly true.
The breeze trailing over the monkey looks quite pleasant too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Different places, different winds.
Fufu... It seems there is no such thing as a Matsubori wind here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, over here is a big Paku-paku-san.
This Hayate... seems to be quite hungry.
choice_data_list: Looks like we can feed them. Wanna try?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly. I would love to join
in this land's swirling breath of life as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu. What a fierce wind.
It's brimming with powerful vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Some nature is sustained by the hands of humans and horse girls.
These are the lessons and memories that became my coastal breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed like a fulfilling day for her, but since it's White Day, I should get her a lasting gift—
choice_data_list: Hmm... What's that! Zephyr, hold on a sec

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I bought some potpourri at the souvenir shop. They said it was made using flowers from the garden I had just walked through with Yamanin Zephyr.
choice_data_list: Here, this is for you. You liked the scent, right?
Here, this is for you. You liked the scent, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You took note of how
I was captivated by the fragrant breeze...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I am so happy... With this,
I can look back on today's flower-scented breeze as many times as I want—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Oohk? Oohk-k-k~~!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you scared me...! Are you okay, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Yes, I am Zephyr.
However, my potpourri was stolen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I shall have that back.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself; I can always go buy some more, you know?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, it has to be that...!

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Kya!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Closing the distance on the monkey in a flash, Yamanin Zephyr snatched the potpourri back...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please don't dry yourself in the wind like that anymore.
You need to properly reflect on what you did.

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Ukyan... Ukyakya.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're reflecting on it.
Looks like you're reflecting on it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, the potpourri has returned as well. We managed to avoid the ill winds.
choice_data_list: So a new one wouldn't do?
Couldn't you have just used a new one?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...When I received the potpourri,
the spring easterly breeze caressed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That joy was a breeze belonging only to that moment.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if I were to receive the same gift again,
I doubt the same wind would blow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To me, this wanderer's life is precious.
It is my one and only gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze... Come to think of it,
last Valentine's Day, Yamanin Zephyr wished
to 'become a gentle breeze.'
choice_data_list: I wonder if I've gotten any closer to what you wished for back then?
I wonder if I've gotten any closer to what you wished for back then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My... wish—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The bright breeze I tried to embrace back then
...no, something far warmer and more passionate now resides in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It is not a wind that belongs to me alone.
It is the favorable wind born of the time we spent together—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "This gentle breeze belongs to you and me. Enough for the two of us."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt a slight presence.
The sheer strength of a seed ready to sprout."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Beyond nurturing these feelings with care lies a brilliant breeze unlike anything ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us go once more.
Believing that the wind will blow ahead of our path.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I have indeed found a new, radiant breeze.
However, this is not the end.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind whispers to me.
It says you will bring
the winds of a new world once again...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think so too.
If it's you, I'm sure...
